description: This file contains the implementation of RoleAuthorizationHandler, a class that handles authorization logic for roles and users within the OrchardCore framework, including permission variation based on roles and user-specific checks.

classes.name: RoleAuthorizationHandler
classes.description: A sealed class that extends AuthorizationHandler to handle permission checks for roles and users, with lazy loading of services and role-based permission variation.

methods.name: HandleRequirementAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to handle authorization requirements based on roles and user permissions, including special cases for user editing and role-based permissions.

methods.name: GetPermissionVariation
methods.description: A static helper method that returns a role-specific variation of a permission based on the permission's name.
